Medobrēga (Medubrīga, Mun-dobrīga ), ae, f.,
I.a city in Lusitania, now Portalegre, Auct. B. Alex. 48, 4.—Hence, Medubrīgenses , ĭum, m., the inhabitants of Medobrega, Auct. B. Alex. 48; Plin. 4, 22, 35, § 118; “al. Medubricenses.—Also written ‡ MEIDVBRIGENSES,” Inscr. Orell. 162 .
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
